Build your algebra fluency before Year 11. Work through the five units at your own pace with paper, a pen and your Year 10 Cambridge textbook.

[Explore the five units](courses/year-11-advanced/holiday-preparation/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## How to use the program

::: {.learning-rhythm}
::: {.rhythm-part}
### Work through a lesson

[15–20 minutes]{.time-label}

Try each question on paper, then reveal the working and check your method.
:::
::: {.rhythm-part}
### Practise independently

[About 40 minutes]{.time-label}

Complete the selected textbook questions and correct your work. At the end of each unit, record what you can do independently.
:::
:::
